variants.name: 대각선 클러스터
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / precise-object-edit.
Make ONE complete alternative gameplay HUD concept, SAME ultra-wide1920:800 aspect ratio, full game screenshot only, highest practical resolution, no external labels, no comparison sheet, no watermark.
INPUT ROLES STRICT: Image1 is the DIRECT EDIT TARGET, a freshly captured CURRENT GAME screenshot. Image2 is the USER'S CHOSEN HUD ART STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Transfer Image2's HUD inkbrush/illustration/typographic style but ABSOLUTELY NOT its older dark empty environment, character arrangement, camera, obsolete HUD state or input keys. All WORLD content must come from Image1.
CURRENT WORLD LOCK: Keep Image1's camera/framing and all actual floor/wall geometry: bright periwinkle floor tiles,02 markings/circular floor decals, blue-purple chamfered block cover with pale flat tops, tall detailed facility power/service/coolant panels across upperedge, dark navy peripheral maintenance floor with vents and pipes, pink actual gates. Preserve main olive mech at center/right, ongoing sword pose, sparks/rocket trails/explosions/smoke/debris, THREE visible white cube red-eyed enemies (upper-center, left-mid, left-upper affected by a white impactflash), cyan mechanical cleaning drone lower-right partly under oldHUD. Do not repaint/recolor the world or change lighting, move props/actors, add characters, change enemy silhouettes or erase physical effects.
Completely replace only all ORIGINAL screen HUD; restore background in its footprints. Remove original central LOCKx3 HUD text so mech remains readable; present small LOCKx3 secondary banner under mission readout. Remove original world energydots and duplicate old healthbars. No new decorative lettering across the arena.
MATCH CHOSEN STYLE CLOSELY: bold angular handdrawn ink, black brush plates with jagged but controlled edges, cream strong italic display lettering, vivid red slashes, turquoise illustrated gadgets. A large beautifully inked OLIVE MECH HEAD/SHOULDERS portrait tucked into player HUD like Image2 (not a hexagon emblem). Chunky hand-illustrated gun/sword/rocket/boot/gadget icons, cream PC-key tabs. Stylistically coherent professional action-comic game graphics. Compact and readable, all corners with safe margins, keep center open. No pastel capsules, ivory dashboards, metal screws/bevels, cyber holographic circuitry, tiny noisy ornamental marks or white sticker outlines.
Carry CURRENT Image1 state: player health5/5 (ALL5segments GREEN), orange boostline, 3 small energyunits shown ONCE in player panel; ROOMS0/9, ENEMIES4, SCORE0; GUN ammo14/30; ROCKET0(disabledgray). Partner TRIAD FOLLOW support0/100 EMPTY, portrait faithfully depicts existing round cyan mechanical casing/modules with NO digital face/screen/eyes; Q DOCK and X SHIELD disabled gray, Z CLEAN turquoise active. The old G DOCK from Image2 is obsolete: use Q.
Actions: sword LMB, gun RMB/T+14/30, dodge SPACE, rush E, laser L+R, rocket R0gray, small separate SHIFT BOOST caption. Key labels large readable and separate from illustrated shapes. No fake currencies, timers, healing abilities or ready status.
REQUIRED enemy healthbars: exactly ONE short RED bar with black emptytail and cream thinoutline above EACH of the THREE visible CUBE enemies: upper-center cube body near x.42,y.20 (bararoundx.42,y.12); left-mid cube body near x.24,y.47 (bararoundx.235,y.38); left-upper flash-affected cube near x.215,y.28 (bararoundx.21,y.23). Replace their old tan bars, no duplicates. Roughly1bodywidth, never long arena-wide bars. Illustrative fills80/60/40percent, not actual numericHP. NEVER add bars to FRIENDLY cyan drone near x.855,y.65, floorblocks, equipment panels or UI portraits. Preserve all3enemy poses/locations.

VARIANT1: CLOSEST TO SELECTED ART, SLASH CLUSTER. Rich large olive mech-bust portrait at top-left with comic ink/hard flat highlights and narrow red framing slashes; compact five-slanted-green-block health and cream5/5 beside it. A blackbrush mission+map compound at top-right like chosen reference, cream rooms, red enemies, small cyan inkmap, scorefooter. At bottom-left a long but low blackbrush companion strip with cyan mechanically faithful drone illustration spilling slightly above plateedge, emptythin supportline and Q/X/Z tabs. Bottom-right six individual jagged ink weapon plates in a tight TWO-ROW diagonally rising action cluster like chosen reference: top SPACE,E,R0; bottom gunRMB/T14/30,L+R,swordLMB. Red primary sword plate largest, cyan gadget drawings, cream key tabs, minimal thin red swishes. Small SHIFT BOOST tab alongside top-row. These are energetic painterly black brush shapes, NOT rectangular chrome buttons. Icon craftsmanship and mech portrait are focal HUD features. Keep panels compact and well within frame. This should clearly feel like another iteration of the exact selected design.
